WestsideOur promise

We will take shoppers from the post to the billing counter.

Every idea here ends inside a Westside store and is judged on how many more people walk in. Together the three ideas target 15 mn impressions in twelve weeks.

01

Test it once

One city for twelve weeks, built around a store launch or the wedding season.

02

Your footfall and your bills, read against stores that did not get the programme.

03

No result, nothing to pay

If the numbers don’t move, you lose nothing.

Westside01 · Westside today · How Westside talks

Westside’s everyday voice is warm, and its events are editorial.

Four themes run through both, but we found nothing that takes people from a post or an event into a store.

What Westside says now

  • New Indian talent. YNG creators, 30 New Faces, FRONT ROW.
  • Culture beyond clothes. I-pop, dance-offs, fitness runs.
  • Women together. Wesness runs in four cities.
  • Own labels first. Bombay Paisley, E.T.A, Utsa, Vark, W Edit.

Where we take it

  • Show shoppers the 400–500 new designs a week, store by store.
  • Tell one wedding-season story, in the windows and on Instagram.
  • Give every new store the same local launch, styled from its rails.
  • End every post and every event in a store, and count the visit.
Sources: Trent investor presentations, Indian Retailer, westside.com.07 / 33

Westside02 · The opportunity · The look code

One look code takes a shopper from the post to the billing counter.

The code tells the store team which look you want and tells us which post brought you in, so Westside can see what marketing adds to each store.

01

Made in store

Built from one store’s rails.

02

Posted that week

On Westside, creator and city pages.

03

Tagged with a code

On every post, cup sleeve and window card.

04

Shown at the store

The team brings the look in your size.

05

Logged at billing

Matched to member bills by Westside’s analysts.

The code is never a discount. Store teams get one short briefing a week on the looks and how to log the code.

Westside03 · The three ideas · Overview

Each idea builds on something Westside already runs.

Together they target 15 mn impressions in one city over twelve weeks. We commit to beat Westside’s best comparable campaign of the last year by at least 20%.

No. 01Styled by Westside

Stylists and creators build looks in store every week, each with a code.

Builds on YNG’s creators and the weekly new designs.

4.9 mnimpressions
No. 02The Westside Coffee Cart

Drinks named after Westside labels, with a look code on every cup.

Builds on Wesness, which already starts runs at Westside stores.

5.4 mnimpressions
No. 03Window Stories

Two mannequins in a story, with every piece sold inside.

Builds on FRONT ROW’s New Faces, cast in the window Reels.

4.7 mnimpressions

Westside03 · Idea 1 of 3
No. 01Concept drawing
Styled by Westside

Make styling the reason people follow Westside.

Almost everything Westside sells is its own label, and its designers create 400–500 new designs a week. Most shoppers never see how those pieces go together.

What it is

Every week our stylists and YNG creators build complete looks from one Westside store, film them on the shop floor and post them.

How it ends in a store

You see one saree styled three ways, every piece from your nearest Westside. You show its code, LOOK 027, in store, and the team brings the whole outfit in your size.

One piece, three ways

From office to dinner to a family function.

Style me for…

A creator brings a real occasion.

Head to toe, one budget

Clothes, shoes and Studiowest make-up, with the total on screen.

Stylist vs creator

Same brief, and the audience picks.

Designs as reported by Retail Insight Network, 20 Jul 2026. Own labels: BW Businessworld, 2026. Drawing is a concept.14 / 33

Westside03 · Idea 2 of 3
No. 02Concept render
The Westside Coffee Cart

Every cup from the cart carries a look to try on in store.

The cart goes where people already gather, from Westside forecourts to malls and colleges, with Westside’s labels on the menu. City and food pages film it, so people who never pass it still see it.

What it is

A Westside-designed coffee cart outside Westside stores, in malls, at colleges and in office parks. A coffee partner sells at café prices, with no free cups.

How it ends in a store

You order a Nuon Cold Brew outside the store. The sleeve carries a look code, and inside the team brings the look in your size.

On the menu

  • Bombay Paisley Filter
  • Nuon Cold Brew
  • Gia Hazelnut Latte
  • E.T.A Flat White
  • Utsa Masala Chai
  • Vark Rose Cardamom
Menu names use Westside’s own labels. Image is a concept render.18 / 33

Westside03 · Idea 3 of 3
No. 03Concept drawing · 7:45 pm
Window Stories

Rahul and Anjali are getting ready for a date.

A window that tells a familiar story gives people walking past a Westside store a reason to stop and photograph it.

What it is

Two mannequins dressed for a moment everyone knows, with every piece on them for sale inside. The story changes every four weeks, and each store picks its own.

How it ends in a store

Each look is priced on a card in the window, with a code to ask for it in store. Anjali’s dressing table is set with Studiowest, priced on the same card.

Who is in the Reels

FRONT ROW’s New Faces play the couples, filmed at the window by store teams and local creators.

Concept drawing. Character names are working titles.21 / 33

Westside05 · The test · The offer

Start with one city. If the numbers don’t move, you lose nothing.

All three ideas run in one twelve-week test, read on footfall per store. You choose what the test is built around.

Option A · recommended

A store launch

Your next opening and its city, with looks styled from its rails before it opens and a cart outside from opening weekend.

Option B

The wedding season

One city through the wedding dates, with looks for every function and wedding Window Stories in every store.

If it works

You pay our fee, plus production and media up to an agreed cap.

If it doesn’t

No fee. We carry production and media up to that cap.

What we need

A test city, matched stores, counter and bill data, a code field at billing. We also need stock depth on featured looks and sign-off on posts within 48 hours.
